LanguageData.PhobosRadioLog_NoAwards: No awards yet. Collect QSL cards to earn them.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioLog_NoCards: No cards yet. The first contact with each settlement earns its card.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioLog_NoFriends: Nobody here has a radio friend yet.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioLog_FriendLine: {COLONIST} and {FRIEND} of {FACTION}: {STAGE}, {HOURS} hours on the radio.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioLog_NoneInReach: No settlement of a faction that talks is in reach of this colony's stations.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioLog_NeighbourAccepted: {COLONIST} is on the radio for {FACTION}, who asked for help.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioLog_NeighbourDone: {COLONIST} finished an hour on the radio for {FACTION}: {GOODWILL} goodwill.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_Earned: A QSL card from {PLACE} ({FACTION}): {OPERATOR}'s first contact there, report {REPORT}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_CardText:
To {OURCALL}, operator {OPERATOR}.
{DATE}, {UTC} UTC. Grid square {GRID}.
{WORKED}Your signal {REPORT}, {TILES} km.
{NOTE}
73, {FACTION}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingOwnCallsignDesc: Printed on every QSL card the colony receives, in place of the one worked out from its place on the planet. Letters, digits and a stroke (VK3ABC/P), up to ten. Leave it empty to have one worked out.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_TurnOver: Click to turn the card over.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteFirstContact0: Pse QSL, tnx. Good to hear a new voice on the air.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteFirstContact1: The first of many contacts, we hope.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteFirstContact2: Your signal came out of the noise like a lamp in the dark.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteAdvice0: Glad our help got through. Call again if you need us.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteAdvice1: Hope it all held together. Good luck out there.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteAdvice2: A steady hand is only a radio call away.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteFactionCall0: Tnx for the call. We listen on this frequency.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteFactionCall1: Keep in touch. The world is quieter than it should be.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteFactionCall2: Our door is open, and so is our channel.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteFriend0: Good chatting, as always. Talk soon.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteFriend1: Our operator says hello to yours.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteFriend2: Tnx for the company on a long night.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteNeighbour0: Tnx for the help. We owe you one.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteNeighbour1: Your operator talked us through it. Much obliged.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteNeighbour2: Without you we would still be stuck. Many thanks.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_Award: Our station has earned an award: {AWARD}. Those who work the radio are proud of it.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_AwardAllFactions: Worked every faction on the air
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_AwardLongWay: A contact {TILES} km away or more
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_ItemDescription: A card from {CALL} at {PLACE} ({FACTION}), confirming {OPERATOR}'s contact by radio: signal {REPORT}, {TILES} km.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_ReadBenefit: A small lift in mood for the reader, more for a card from far away.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_BureauPost: Post from the QSL bureau: {COUNT} QSL cards, brought by {FACTION}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_CertificateText: A certificate awarded to the radio station of {COLONY}: {AWARD}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_AwardAllBiomes: Worked every kind of land a station stands on
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_AwardFarSide: A contact {KM} km away or more: the far side of the world
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_AwardAllLandmasses: Worked every landmass with a station on it
LanguageData.PhobosRadioRare_Text: A rare station is on the air for a few hours: {CALL}, {KIND}, in the {AREA} area. An HF station may call it while a band is open to it, for a rare QSL card.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioRare_CallDesc: Call the rare station {CALL} on HF. It answers only while a band is open to it; the HF bands tab shows how far each band reaches this hour.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioRare_NotOpen: {CALL} cannot be heard now: no band is open to it from here. Try another hour, or a higher antenna.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_EarnedRare: A rare QSL card from {CALL}, {PLACE}: {OPERATOR} worked it, report {REPORT}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_EarnedListener: {OPERATOR} heard {CALL} at {PLACE}, report {REPORT}, though they could not hear us: a listener's card.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteRare0: Thanks for the call from so far away. Few get through to us out here.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteRare1: Our only contact this side of the world today. Tnx and 73.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteRare2: Signals were hard work here. Glad yours made it.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteListener0: Heard, not worked: tnx for your listener's report.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteListener1: We never heard you, but glad you heard us. Call again with more power.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioQsl_NoteListener2: A listener's card, with thanks. Maybe next time both ways.
